title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (South Carolina)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due November 1 for general property. A negative report is required even when the business holds nothing. Reports are filed electronically; paper checks are not accepted. The State Treasurer's holder brochure sets the review date at June 30. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.
